narr: Severe thunderstorms developed across portions of the Big Country, the Concho Valley and the Heartland due to strong instability and strong wind shear. The severe thunderstorms produced large hail and damaging winds.
ev: Fire Department reported interior flooding to homes and flooded roadways. Also, 4 inches of rain fell with large hail (size unknown).
lsr: 4 inches of rain fell along with large hail, with reports of interior flooding to homes and flooded roadways.
